julia (Customer): Hey team, we noticed embeddings suddenly dropped from 1024 dims to 1536 dims for our app. Broke similarity lookup.

sam (Support): Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste a curl request you used? Also which project/org header are you sending?

julia (Customer): Here's the curl we've been using (no changes on our side):

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-xxxx' \n  -H 'Redwood-Project: project-abc' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"input":"some text"}'
```

sam (Support): Ok — what's the exact response shape / dims?

julia (Customer): Response has embedding length 1536. We run similarity index expecting 1024 vectors -> everything misaligned.

sam (Support): Hmm. Can you confirm which model you expect? (was this redwood-embed-1024?)

julia (Customer): Yes, we pinned redwood-embed-1024 in our console. We didn't change anything. Billing shows requests under project-abc.

sam (Support): I'm escalating to eng-ml. @anya can you take a look? Repro steps and headers above.

anya (ML Eng): Looking. Quick hypothesis: org-scoped API key vs project header precedence might be selecting a different default model. Sending initial checklist: 1) full request headers (including any X-Org or X-Redwood-Org headers), 2) raw response meta.model field if present, 3) example request id.

julia (Customer): added X-Org: org-789 to our outgoing proxy for routing. Full raw response below:

```json
{"model":"text-embedding-003","embedding":[...1536 numbers...],"usage":{"input_tokens":3}}
```

sam (Support): That is the smoking gun — model is text-embedding-003 (1536 dims). Our redwood-embed-1024 is 1024 dims. The X-Org header likely caused request routing to fall back to a default model for that org which hasn't been configured to prefer redwood-embed-1024.

anya (ML Eng): Confirmed. Repro on staging: if request includes X-Org (or x-org-id) and project header is present, routing currently resolves on org-key precedence and picks the org's default model mapping. If the org's default is an upstream model (text-embedding-003) we return 1536 dims.

mike (Infra): This is an auth-routing priority issue introduced last week when we merged org-key fastpath to improve multi-tenant routing. The change set bumped org-key precedence above project header.

sam (Support): Customers who rely on project header model pinning will be affected. We need a mitigation and root fix.

anya (ML Eng): Mitigation options: 1) quick rollback of precedence change (hotfix), 2) server-side patch to prefer explicit Redwood-Project header over org default when model pin exists, 3) send 4xx warning when model dims mismatch expected dims. My preference: implement 2 and send a warning/error in the short term.

mike (Infra): Rolling back is fastest for immediate relief. Patch + tests will take a few hours. We can also add a validation layer that checks expected embedding dims from project configuration and returns a 409 with explanatory message — that prevents silent breakage.

sam (Support): For this specific customer: julia, do you want us to switch routing for your project now (manual override) while we push the rollback?

julia (Customer): Yes please, we need it fixed ASAP. Our similarity pipeline is down.

anya (ML Eng): Created temporary override: pinned project-abc to redwood-embed-1024 at 1778880015. Also adding a quick server-side validation that compares model dims to project-config expected dims and logs an error.

ops-bot: action=override_apply project=project-abc model=redwood-embed-1024 actor=anya ts=1778880015

sam (Support): Julia — can you retry your request now?

julia (Customer): Re-tested, embedding length is back to 1024, similarity index OK. Thanks! :relieved:

anya (ML Eng): Next steps: 1) mike to roll back the precedence merge within 2–4 hours and ship tests to ensure project header wins when explicitly pinned, 2) add dims validation (409) and warning in console, 3) add a monitoring alert for sudden per-project embedding-dim changes, 4) update docs about header precedence and recommended headers.

mike (Infra): I'm working on rollback now. Will post deploy ts.

sam (Support): We'll follow up with formal incident ticket and notify affected customers. Julia — I'll send an incident summary and confirm no billing impact.

julia (Customer): Appreciate the fast help. Please let me know when the final fix is live so we can remove our X-Org header workaround.

anya (ML Eng): I'll push the code change for precedence + dims-check and link the PR here once ready.

mike (Infra): rollback complete, deploy at 1778880024. Monitoring shows project-abc dims stable at 1024.

sam (Support): Closing the thread — feel free to reopen if you see anything.

julia (Customer): Confirmed all good. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
